newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indonesia's US$500 mln credit facility allotted.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's US$500 mln credit facility allotted.

text.p: Indonesia's US$500 million eight-year syndicated credit facility has been allotted, JP Morgan said on Friday.
The interest rate will be calculated at an annual rate equal to the London Interbank Offered Rate plus a margin of five-eighths of one percent.
Proceeds will be used to provide general purpose funds for the Republic of Indonesia.

Coordinating arrangers and lead managers, with US$24,702,857 each, are Commerzbank (South East Asia), Fuji Bank, IBJ Asia, JP Morgan Securities Asia, NatWest Markets, Sanwa International Finance and Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK).

Arrangers and lead managers, with US$15,720,000 each, are Asahi Bank's Singapore branch, Bank of Taiwan's Tokyo branch, Banque Nationale de Paris's Singapore branch, Chase Manhattan Asia, Commonwealth Bank of Australia's Singapore branch, Daiwa Overseas Finance, DKB Asia, Dresdner (South East Asia), Korea Development Bank, LTCB Asia, Nippon Credit Bank's Singapore branch, Norinchukin Bank's Singapore branch, Sakura Merchant Bank (Singapore) and Tokai Bank's Singapore branch.

Co-arrangers and lead managers, with US$10 million each, are Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp Singapore, Mitsui Trust and Banking Singapore, Shinhan Finance, Sumitomo Trust and Banking Corp, Toyo Trust and Banking Singapore, and Yasuda Trust and Banking Singapore.
Senior managers with US$5 million each, are Banco Exterior de Espana Hong Kong, Chuo Trust and Banking Hong Kong, Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Singapore, Sumitomo Bank Singapore and Zenshinren Bank.

Managers, with US$3 million each, are E Sun Commercial Bank, Eighteen Bank Hong Kong, Hanil Bank, Industrial Bank of Korea Singapore, Iyo Bank Hong Kong, Taiwan Cooperative Bank, Chukyo Bank and Taiwan Business Bank.
